Title: Azure Ultra Disk is now available in more regions

Body.Content:
Azure Ultra Disk is now available in Australia Central, India Central, Korea Central and US Gov Texas. Azure Ultra Disks offer high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure VMs.

Learn More
